choices: The brain's capacity to reshape its own wiring through neuroplasticity
The offloading of computational work from a neural control system onto the physical dynamics of the body
The genome's computation of an organism's optimal adult body shape
The use of morphine-like neuromodulators to tune neural computation
explanation: Morphological computation occurs when a body's physical properties — mass distribution, compliance, elasticity, geometry — automatically solve problems that would otherwise require explicit neural calculation. Passive dynamic walkers, tensegrity structures, and octopus arms are examples. It concerns the body's mechanics doing cognitive work, not neuroplasticity, genomic shape determination, or neuromodulation.
